d: Business Development Manager (BDM) – Prime Hub, Muscat
Prime Hub is Oman’s leading Marketing and Media House, specializing in outdoor, digital, and experiential advertising.
We’re expanding our dynamic team and looking for a Business Development Manager (BDM) to drive growth, partnerships, and new business opportunities across our media network.
Identify and develop new business opportunities in traditional and digital advertising.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, agencies, and partners.
Collaborate with internal teams on campaign planning, execution, and performance.
Develop proposals, negotiate contracts, and ensure client satisfaction.
Represent Prime Hub at industry events, exhibitions, and client meetings.
Monitor market trends and competitors to identify growth opportunities.
Minimum 5 years of experience in traditional and digital advertising, preferably within the OOH or events industry.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
Proficient in Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
IT fluency and ability to adapt to digital tools and CRM systems.
Be part of Oman’s fastest-growing media company.
Work with top brands and national-scale projects.
Growth-oriented environment with exciting challenges and rewards.
